cheapest.verdict: Flamingo Las Vegas, Flamingo Room | 2 Queens: $581 for 7 nights (Feb 15–22, 2027), including a $50/day resort fee, before taxes.
cheapest.runnerUp: South Point, Premium 2 Queens: $989 for the same seven nights including all fees, before taxes.
cheapest.delta: $408 more at South Point for the week. Flamingo is center Strip; South Point is at the south end of the Las Vegas Strip.
cheapest.caveat: These are snapshot rates from one capture. A rate is not a reservation, and taxes are excluded. Caesars Palace itself moved from $226 to $214 per night between 2026-11-26 and 2026-11-27 (F-23), so treat every total as a reading, not a price.

dateVerdict.statement: Among the windows actually captured, Feb 15–22, 2027 is cheaper than the following week at the only hotel that quoted both: South Point charges $989 vs $1,049 for a two-queen room (+$60, about 6%). The March 15–22 window could not be quoted at all because March 20, 2027 shows no availability.
dateVerdict.cannotSay: This is not proof that Feb 15–22 is the cheapest week in the whole window. Only one property produced comparable quotes across windows, and no historical or forward rate series was retrieved. Some March dates are already sold out, which is itself a reason not to wait.

bookTiming.statement: No official source publishes an optimal booking lead time. What is verified: Caesars Entertainment advertises 'Advanced Purchase Savings — up to 30% off for stays 30+ days in advance' and free cancellation within 48 hours. Booking now (≈80 days before Feb 15, 2027) already satisfies the 30-day threshold.

bookTiming.action: Book a refundable/free-cancellation two-queen room now as a hedge, then recheck the same dated engines weekly and rebook if the rate falls. Cancellation terms must be read on the booking page — the 48-hour term was not fully retrieved.
